title: Stop falling for monthly subscription trading bots.
author: _HaZzArD_
selftext: tbh, most of those ads you see are just monthly subscription traps selling a pipe dream. the minute you cancel, your so-called 'edge' is gone. ended up switching to kronos trading mostly because it’s just a one-time lifetime deal. my funds stay in my own broker account, and the bot literally just handles the TradingView webhook execution.
